description: This file defines a directory helper class 'dir' with static methods for filesystem operations such as checking writability, recursive deletion, and content listing.

classes.name: dir
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for directory management, including checking writability, recursive pruning, and directory content retrieval.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if a directory is writable by attempting to create and delete a temporary file within it.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents, returning success status or list of failed deletions.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Returns the list of files in a directory, with options for filtering and path inclusion.

methods.name: fileSort
methods.description: Helper function to sort filenames case-insensitively.
